name: paper_faithful
description: Settings the KAIROS paper states (Sec. 4.2, 4.3, 5, 5.1.1). Anything the paper does not state is marked UNSTATED and mirrored in docs/deviations.md.

_provenance.decoder: paper Sec. 4.2 (MLP, cross-entropy). Paper says nine edge types; StreamSpot has 26, so output dim is 26 (deviation D-07)
_provenance.node_state_dim, neighbors, edge_embeddin: paper Sec. 5. edge_embedding_dim 200 = two 100-dim node embeddings concatenated (deviation D-18)
_provenance.graph_score: paper Sec. 4.3.1 and 4.3.3; population SD is our choice (UNSTATED)
_provenance.threshold: paper: set from benign validation data (Sec. 4.3.3). 'Max' is from the authors' code (UNSTATED in paper)
_provenance.node_feature: UNSTATED for StreamSpot (no paths or IPs, so hierarchical hashing does not apply); one-hot type follows the authors' code
_provenance.optimizer, lr, epochs, batch_size, atten: UNSTATED in paper; values from the authors' StreamSpot code (confirm against source)
